'''Rodney Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th after Swiss at [[1999 Calamari Regionals]] on 16 October 1999, according to Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d87">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-26-melbourne-australia-16-oct-99d87/ melbourne-australia-16-oct-99], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 26 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-26-melbourne-australia-16-oct-99d87/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
